title: Engagements designed around the level of uncertainty, implementation, and ongoing stewardship the work requires.
summary: Aloha AI offers bounded diagnostics, architecture projects, implementation scopes, retained operating support, research systems, licensing, and institutional partnerships.
audience: Prospective clients and partners deciding what form of engagement matches their problem and readiness.
timeline: Diagnostics are usually the shortest entry point; architecture, implementation, retained support, and licensing are scoped from validated needs.
fit: The organization needs a clear starting point
A project requires explicit acceptance and handoff conditions
methodology: Clarify the decision and desired change
assumptions: A decision maker participates in scoping
The parties agree on authority, confidentiality, and access
limitations: Timelines and pricing vary with complexity, access, and risk
